settings.title: Settings
settings.restoreMessage: All game settings will return to their original values.

display.imageRenderingSharpDescription: Enlarges to a whole multiple and then shrinks with a high-quality filter: the pixel art stays crisp, but no pixel is wider than its neighbours.
display.imageRenderingSmoothDescription: Blends neighbouring pixels when scaling. The softest result, and never uneven.
display.imageRenderingLanczosDescription: High-quality resampling that keeps fine detail sharp while removing the uneven pixels.
display.imageRenderingScale2xDescription: Edge-aware pixel art scaling: rounds off staircase diagonals and keeps flat colours perfectly flat.
display.imageRenderingCrtDescription: Pixel art scaling with faint scanlines, like an old monitor.
display.imageRenderingCrispDescription: Keeps lines sharp without blurring the colours. At fractional zoom some pixels can still look wider than others.
display.scaleDescription: Reduce the number of rendered pixels.

nowPlaying.title: Now Playing
nowPlaying.description: Show a card naming the music that just started playing.
